description.value: Turtle Bay Pub is a family-friendly waterfront pub on Wood Lake in Lake Country, open year-round and welcoming dogs on its lakeside patio. The menu spans classic pub fare and kids' meals through Pacific Rim-inspired dishes like tuna tataki, Korean fusion tacos, and coconut prawns, paired with a broad selection of BC craft beer and Okanagan VQA wines. The waterfront location and all-season operation make it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists touring the Wine Country Cycling routes through the central Okanagan.

address.value: 2850 Woodsdale Rd, Lake Country, BC V4V 1Y1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at turtlebaypub.com loaded successfully and provides strong primary evidence: phone (250) 766-4534 and address 2850 Woodsdale Rd, Lake Country, BC V4V 1Y1 are explicitly listed; a dedicated 'Take Out & Delivery' navigation section confirms takeout; the FAQ explicitly states gluten-free dishes are available. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, year-round waterfront pub with confirmed customer washrooms, takeout service, and gluten-free options in a cycling-popular Okanagan community; a clear fit for the WWC directory.
